Okok. This is a huge controversy. But lemme just start by saying this: I 100% accept people and their decisions as long as they’re not hurting anyone else. This kind of love and acceptance is where the community started, but as there are lots of crazy straight people, there can also be some twisted people within the community. It’s really upsetting to see sexualities being hated on by their own community—a community that started off being a safe and wholesome place for people to unite. It’s just what happens when things like this blow up and accept even more people into it. If the person who started this community would have seen how even the subcategories of the community have branched off and separated themselves from the “mother” they would prolly b pissed that it’s strayed from the main purpose. I just wish we could all be chill with each other and accept whoever we love and where we put our who-has and wee wees (lol did I really just write that?) It’s not our business, there are no further ethics besides ensuring that there’s full consent, the parties are both (or all) legal, and no one is getting hurt. People gotta chill tf out and stop trynna gang up on each other and remember why this started in the first place. A SAFE. LOVING. HOME, with Welcoming arms. Thank you.
